shared_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a single landscape 3:2 photograph for a Japanese house-cleaning service demonstration. This must look like a close, ordinary on-site photograph during a real cleaning job, not an advertisement, showroom, product render or room overview. Identify the actual surface or inside part being cleaned and point the camera at that surface. Use a straight-on view when that reveals the target; use an overhead or slightly angled view only when physically necessary to see an interior or corner. The target should fill most of the frame. Natural room light, honest surface texture and wear, slight water droplets or practical cleaning evidence, restrained colors, everything physically plausible. Do not exaggerate grime. Absolutely no people, faces, hands, arms, gloves, body parts or human reflections. No lettering, labels, logos, watermark, arrows, split view, collage or before/after text. No luxurious styling, decorative plants or cinematic shallow focus. A single relevant cleaning tool may rest naturally in the scene, but nothing floats or operates without a support.

scenes.aircon-wall: Directly face the exposed heat-exchanger fins of a wall-mounted air conditioner at close range. Silver wet fins, black crossflow fan visible below, white casing edges and a protective washing bag below. The internal parts occupy the frame, not the room.
scenes.washer-top: Look down through the fully open mouth of a top-loading washing machine into the stainless washing tub. Show the circular bottom hub with pulsator removed, perforated tub walls and wet seams. The removed pulsator rests on a protective towel at the far edge. Emphasize the interior rather than the lid.
scenes.washer-front: Look straight into the open circular door of a front-loading washing machine. Fill the frame with the wet stainless drum and rubber gasket groove, a small amount of loosened residue in the lower fold. The detergent drawer rests on a towel at the bottom edge.
scenes.kitchen-fan: Overhead close photograph of a disassembled range hood cylindrical blower and metal mesh filter resting in a stainless sink. Fine foam and modest loosened cooking grease on the blades and filter, a small cleaning brush resting alongside. The actual parts fill the image.
scenes.kitchen-sink: Close overhead view of a stainless kitchen sink, strainer lifted beside the open drain, faucet base and basin corners visible. Droplets, a small patch of fine cleaning foam and a folded cloth at the edge. Show the surfaces and joints that need cleaning, not a whole kitchen.
scenes.aircon-ceiling: Point the camera upward squarely into an opened four-way ceiling cassette air conditioner at close range. Its square outer grille is removed, exposing the realistic circular blower, fins and condensate pan within the white frame. A clear protective sheet catches droplets below the lower edge. Show the mechanism, not the entire ceiling.
scenes.bathroom: Close view into the bottom inside corner of an ordinary white Japanese bathtub, camera just above the rim looking down so the drain, curved tub wall and narrow caulk joint are fully visible. Wet ceramic-like resin surface, small patch of foam and a brush resting flat near the drain. Modest softened water scale at the seam.
scenes.bath-pipe: Close view inside a Japanese bathtub directly facing the round recirculation inlet on the tub side wall just above its bottom. The metal perforated cover has been removed and rests on a wet cloth in the tub, exposing the small realistic inlet fitting. Tiny bubbles in a shallow layer of water. The fitting and adjacent seam dominate the image.
scenes.bath-dryer: Close camera pointed squarely upward at the open vent of a Japanese bathroom ceiling dryer. Grille removed, internal dark fan blades and filter slots clearly visible in the white rectangle. The removable dusty mesh filter rests on a nearby safely supported platform along bottom edge. Ordinary bathroom ceiling, no room overview.
scenes.toilet: Close downward photograph through an open white toilet bowl from directly above the front rim. Clearly show inner porcelain rim, waterline and narrow hinge seam near top edge, with small cleaning bubbles and water droplets. A compact brush rests on a protected floor edge outside the bowl. No full room, no person.
scenes.lavatory: Close view downward into a small white bathroom vanity sink with drain stopper lifted beside the opening. Faucet base and basin joint visible, droplets and thin foam near the overflow. Plain everyday Japanese home basin, no mirror in frame. Show the cleaning surface close enough to see texture.
scenes.refrigerator: Camera directly faces the lower interior of an open household refrigerator at close range. Remove one clear drawer to expose the white shelf rails, back corners and drainage groove. Drawer rests on a towel just below, fine moisture and a folded cleaning cloth on the lower shelf. No food styling or full appliance exterior.
scenes.dishwasher: Close camera looking down into the open tub of a household built-in dishwasher with lower rack pulled out. Round mesh filter and its opening clearly visible at the bottom beside a realistic spray arm. Removed filter rests nearby, fine water droplets and modest food residue being rinsed. No whole kitchen.
scenes.flooring: Close overhead photograph of pale oak floorboards and their joints in an ordinary empty Japanese room during floor cleaning. A flat microfiber mop head rests partly at the edge. A faint damp cleaned path and natural worn texture, not mirror-gloss, show the actual wood floor. Only a narrow skirting edge provides context.
scenes.mattress: Close overhead photograph of a used but tidy white quilted mattress surface and stitched seam. A clear upholstery-extraction nozzle rests flat on the fabric with its hose leading outside frame. Slight damp path and natural woven texture, ordinary on-site cleaning, no staged bedroom.
scenes.sofa: Close photograph facing the junction of an ordinary gray fabric sofa seat cushion and upright back cushion. A small clear upholstery extraction nozzle rests on the seat alongside the seam, hose leaves the frame. Natural woven fabric and modest damp cleaning track. The seam is visible straight on, no whole room.
scenes.carpet: Close downward photograph of short-pile beige carpet fibers and one edge of a resting carpet extraction wand. A subtle freshly cleaned damp strip and ordinary slightly flattened fibers show practical cleaning. Carpet fills the frame, no furniture, no commercial hero styling.
scenes.wall: Close straight-on photograph of a lightly textured off-white vinyl wallcovering beside a narrow vertical join. A small rectangular sponge and folded cloth rest on protective sheet at bottom edge. A small damp cleaned patch, realistic texture and everyday minor discoloration. No wall mural or finished room composition.
scenes.window: Close photograph aimed down into the lower track and inside corner of a sliding aluminum window. Tilt only enough to reveal the recessed track, rubber seal and glass bottom edge. Damp loosened fine dust in the groove and a small brush lying in the track. Natural daylight, no outdoor scenery as main subject.
scenes.entrance: Close overhead view of an ordinary Japanese entrance floor made of square gray ceramic tiles. Damp grout lines, a small scrub brush resting on the tile, and a faint cleaned area demonstrate cleaning. Include only a narrow threshold along one edge, no wide architectural view.
scenes.duct: Close straight-on photograph into an opened circular residential ventilation duct on a white wall. Removed vent cover rests below on protective sheet. Show accessible inside rim, modest dust and cleaning brush resting below. Physically realistic dark duct depth, no fantasy complex machinery.
scenes.air-purifier: Close straight-on photograph of a domestic air purifier with front cover removed. Pleated filter and prefilter grid fill the frame, removed plastic panel rests on a towel below. Slight dust on prefilter edge, small brush at side. Clearly the interior filter rather than a catalog appliance shot.
scenes.wood-coating: Close overhead photograph of honey-colored wood floor boards during protective coating application. A rectangular microfiber applicator pad rests at edge with a restrained wet satin strip across the grain. Natural wood texture and small ordinary wear remain visible, no excessive shine or perfect showroom.
scenes.wood-repair: Close overhead photograph of a small repaired chip in an oak floorboard beside its joint. Show subtle matching filler smoothed almost flush and a narrow putty knife resting on protective cloth at edge. Real grain and ordinary wear, no dramatic staged damage, no arrows or before/after.
scenes.outerwall: Close straight-on photograph of pale exterior siding and its recessed joint at reachable height. A soft wall-cleaning brush rests against a supported ledge at lower edge; faint wet brushing marks and a modest patch of surface dirt show hand washing. No house-wide view or person.
scenes.balcony: Close downward view into the corner of an ordinary Japanese apartment balcony floor near its drain. Wet textured waterproof floor, narrow cleaned path through modest dust, a pressure washer lance resting safely on the floor with no spray operating. Focus on drain and corner, no cityscape.
scenes.grave: Close view squarely facing the lower granite base of a plain uninscribed Japanese grave marker, tilted down just enough to see its horizontal ledge and base joint. Wet granite grain, fine cleaning foam and a soft brush resting on the lower ledge. No names, carved writing or people.
scenes.tools: Close overhead photograph of practical unbranded house-cleaning tools placed on a protective blue sheet on an ordinary home floor: folded white microfiber cloths, two small brushes, plain spray bottle and a shallow tray. Slight use marks, normal indoor light, functional preparation at a job site rather than a styled flat lay. No chemicals labels.
scenes.finish-check: Close overhead photograph of a stainless sink rim and drain immediately after rinsing and wiping, showing a few remaining water droplets and fine natural scratches. A clean folded microfiber cloth rests on the rim. Ordinary home, honest on-site result with clear surface detail, no artificial sparkle.
